attr.title: Geometry Wars 3: Dimensions
attr.desc: Native 32-bit ARM port of the Android version of Geometry Wars 3: Dimensions, running the original libgwnext.so engine through a custom Android-on-Linux loader (KMS/DRM, GLES2, FMOD). You must supply your own copy of the game's OBB and the engine/FMOD .so files from the APK.
attr.inst: Copy main.35.com.activision.gw3.dimensions.obb, libgwnext.so, libfmodex.so and libfmodevent.so into this port's gw3/ folder, then launch. The engine reads the OBB directly.
